policy_matrix.scope: Product-isolated Auth identity and own-account profile
policy_matrix.known_constraint: Current session proves the signed-in account only; email equality does not prove patient or guardian authority.

policy_matrix.scope: Practice, clinic, membership and delegation records
policy_matrix.known_constraint: A secretary grant is a bounded operational permission, not patient-rights representation or practice ownership.

policy_matrix.scope: Patient directory, contact and administrative history
policy_matrix.known_constraint: Shared contact details and duplicate names cannot establish the requester-subject relationship.

policy_matrix.scope: Caregiver, dependent, relationship and consent facts
policy_matrix.known_constraint: Qualification, scope, validity and revocation require independently reviewed evidence; do not infer custody.
Any correction or release needs approved clinical scope and current authorization; synthetic editing is not rights fulfillment.

policy_matrix.scope: Signed notes, prescription versions and amendment provenance
policy_matrix.known_constraint: Preserve immutable versions and amendment chain; no silent rewriting or bulk erasure.

policy_matrix.scope: Private document metadata, objects and access provenance
policy_matrix.known_constraint: Current clinical export excludes Storage bytes; an access request does not authorize an object download.

policy_matrix.scope: Released patient views and recipient-specific restrictions
policy_matrix.known_constraint: Release, revocation and rights requests have distinct purposes and must not broaden each other.

policy_matrix.scope: Practice charges, posted receipts, reversals and allocations
policy_matrix.known_constraint: Keep immutable financial history and original-linked reversals; resolve legal/financial conflicts before any approved outcome.

policy_matrix.scope: Subscriber quotes, notices, independently reviewed funds and periods
policy_matrix.known_constraint: Separate SaaS payer records from practice patient-money records; no shared export or netting.

policy_matrix.scope: Consent, queued synthetic notices and delivery evidence
policy_matrix.known_constraint: A privacy request grants no external delivery permission; unknown dispatch results cannot be blindly resent.

policy_matrix.scope: Access, administrative command and security event provenance
policy_matrix.known_constraint: Minimize disclosed audit facts; preserve independent evidence and third-party confidentiality according to approved policy.

policy_matrix.scope: Encrypted recovery copies and restoration procedures
policy_matrix.known_constraint: No backup expiry or deletion is invented; an approved policy must specify restored-data restrictions and reconciliation.

proposed_case_contract.state_transition_authority: Every transition requires an approved product policy and fresh server-side account, subject relationship and scoped permission; these proposed states are not enabled endpoints.
proposed_case_contract.idempotency: Future command keys must bind exact actor, case revision, policy and scope; unknown outcomes require receipt reconciliation, never blind resubmission.
proposed_case_contract.audit_minimization: Store minimized references and scoped outcome facts; no passwords, tokens, verification links, raw clinical payloads or private payment details in review artifacts.
proposed_case_contract.delivery: No external messages or provider activation; recipient identity and approved delivery scope remain separate gates.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: Verified account submits an existing supported review kind
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Record awaiting_review only; no clinical export, correction, erasure or external delivery.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: Requester shares an email or phone with the subject
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Deny relationship inference; keep dependent fulfillment blocked until approved independent identity evidence.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: A legitimate member requests another practice record
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Reject scope expansion and disclose no existence or content outside fresh authorization.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: A previously valid relationship is revoked before execution
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Re-evaluate fresh authority and stop; a prior intake or approval cannot override revocation.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: A requester seeks replacement of a signed clinical version
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Route the conflict for qualified policy/clinical decision; preserve immutable original and provenance.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: An erasure request intersects a possible legal hold
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: No execution until applicability, scope and accountable resolution are approved; no invented duration.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: A mixed case includes patient and SaaS money records
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Partition scopes and accountable decisions; never net ledgers or erase original-linked history.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: Only part of a requested scope can potentially be fulfilled
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Require itemized approved decision, reasons, permitted communication and reviewer evidence; no automatic partial fulfillment.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: A qualified reviewer may refuse all requested scope
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Require approved grounds and accountable review; current awaiting_review intake cannot manufacture a refusal.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: Connection is lost after a future authorized command
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Reconcile the same command and scope against durable receipts before any retry; do not claim success from an HTTP response.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: A requester repeats intake or a future approved case command
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Bind stable request/command identity and payload; do not duplicate work or silently change the scope.

proposed_scenarios.trigger: A recovery copy predates a future approved rights outcome
proposed_scenarios.required_behavior: Use approved restoration/restriction/reconciliation policy; do not reactivate restricted material or fabricate backup deletion.
